en: I've been building a machine that brings Pokémon back from their fossils. And do you know what? It works!
Hold on! Is that a fossil in your bag? An ancient Pokémon is sleeping in it!
Shall my Fossil Regenerator wake it up for you?
Two fossils! The machine can only work on one at a time. Which one?
Splendid! Let's get started right away.
{player} handed the fossil to the Devon researcher.
The Fossil Regenerator is a marvel, but it's a slow one. Why not take a stroll and come back in a while?
No? Well, Devon's machines will be here whenever you change your mind.
Thanks for waiting! Your fossil has come back to life. It was an ancient Pokémon all along!
{player} received Lileep from the Devon researcher!
{player} received Anorith from the Devon researcher!
Look after it. It has waited a very long time to see the world again.
Oh, but your team is full! Make room for it, and come back.
